skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 130% ATK to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks enemies in a cross shape with 3 consecutive strikes, dealing 600% ATK DMG. The last strike has a 100% chance to inflict [Specialized Shatter] on the main target for 3 turns (reduces DMG Reduction by 10%, deals 250% ATK as [Shatter] DMG when attacked, stacks up to 3 times, does not stack with [Shatter]).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Ultimate DMG 600% → 750% ATK. [Specialized Shatter] DMG Reduction reduction 10% → 15%. [Specialized Shatter] DMG 250% → 350% ATK.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: After Melzargard and allies act, extends the enemy's [Specialized Shatter] status to 4 turns. After any character acts, if an enemy character has 3 stacks of [Specialized Shatter], immediately [Detonate] (single [Shatter] DMG of 500% turns into [Detonation] DMG). Removes [Revival] effects from enemies, lasting the whole battle.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: At the start of the battle, remains [Undefeated] for 3 rounds (If receive Non-Crit Fatal DMG, remains 20% HP without getting knocked down, and resist Crit Fatal DMG 3 times. Depends whether the first strike deals Crit DMG). Permanently grants 100% Crit Res Rate and 50% Non-Crit DMG Free, [Immune] against [Charm/Off Battle]

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc:
Undefeated 3 rounds > 5 rounds Resist Fatal Damage 3x > 55x Crit Res Rate 100% > 130% Non-CRIT DMG Free 50% > 65% Notes
1. Detonation cannot be [Evaded], the 1 DMG is due to [Specialized Unyielding] 2. [Shatter] DMG and [Shatter] in the [Detonation] DMG are separately calculated, AS will deal his 200% and Melz will deal its 250% [Shatter] DMG (without keepsake)

effects.desc: Survive non-fatal attacks (hold about 20% HP without collapsing) and resist a limited number of fatal attacks.
PvP (advanced) tier of Resilience — shield ignores stronger damage, only penetrated by advanced breakers.
Activate a stack of damage over time or stored [Collapse] to instantly explode, turning it into an instant multiplier (e.g. 3 times the stored damage).
Status that causes the bearer to be unaffected by a certain effect or type of control, such as [Breakthrough], Stun, or Charm.
Status returns downed units to battle, granting a limited number of respawns that anti-revive effects can remove.
PvP debuff reduces target's Damage Reduction by 10% and deals 250% Shatter damage each time the target is attacked.
